SELECT
  ol.id                AS outage_log_id,
  ol.planned_start,
  ol.planned_end,
  ol.actual_start,
  ol.actual_end,
  ol.is_confirmed,
  ol.location_id,
  l.working_hours,
  l.company_id,
  l.name               AS location_name
FROM outage_logs ol
JOIN locations l ON l.id = ol.location_id
WHERE ol.is_calculated = false
  AND l.is_active = true
  AND (
    ol.actual_end IS NOT NULL 
    OR (ol.planned_end < NOW() AND ol.is_confirmed = false)
  )
ORDER BY ol.created_at ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  id                        AS generator_id,
  consumption_per_hour,
  load_factor,
  accumulated_hours,
  hours_since_last_service,
  current_fuel_litres,
  tank_volume_litres,
  maintenance_interval_hours
FROM generators
WHERE location_id = '{{ $('Calculate intersection').item.json.location_id }}'
  AND is_active = true;

WITH new_session AS (
  INSERT INTO generator_sessions
    (generator_id, outage_log_id, session_start, session_end, duration_hours, fuel_consumed, source)
  VALUES (
    '{{ $json.generator_id }}',
    '{{ $json.outage_log_id }}',
    '{{ $json.session_start }}',
    '{{ $json.session_end }}',
    {{ $json.duration_hours }},
    {{ $json.fuel_consumed }},
    'auto'
  )
  RETURNING id
),
new_fuel_log AS (
  INSERT INTO fuel_logs
    (generator_id, type, volume_litres, session_id)
  SELECT
    '{{ $json.generator_id }}',
    'expense',
    {{ $json.fuel_consumed }},
    id
  FROM new_session
),
update_generator AS (
  UPDATE generators SET
    accumulated_hours        = {{ $json.new_accumulated_hours }},
    hours_since_last_service = {{ $json.new_hours_since_last_service }},
    current_fuel_litres      = {{ $json.new_fuel_litres }}
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.generator_id }}'
)
SELECT id AS session_id FROM new_session;
